note: ABB (the International Bank of Azerbaijan): its TamKart Classic credit card is free, and its annual interest rate is one of 18%, 20%, 22%, 27%, 28% or 29% (an actual rate of 18.40% to 40.60%), written at the top. Kapital Bank's Birbank Star charges a fixed 10 manat for each 500 carried instead of interest, which the game's cards don't model.
